headline: Mooring County and Marban Hollow Ignite as Olavis Wake Erupts
war_summary: Since our previous edition, the heaviest base volatility has shifted squarely into Mooring County and Marban Hollow, while a sudden violent flare-up has rocked Olavis Wake. In Mooring County, combat reached a feverish pitch with eleven base transfers over two hours across contested bastions including Gravekeeper's Holdfast and MacConmara Barrows, generating nearly 4,000 casualties in that span as Colonials defend two remaining bases against nine Warden holds. Marban Hollow saw Checkpoint Bua change hands repeatedly in eleven rapid two-hour events amid mounting losses, leaving the sector split 6–1 in Colonial favor with one base ruined. Further west, Olavis Wake abruptly ignited with five events reducing Koskinla to no-man's-land and over 1,600 casualties reported in the past two hours. Meanwhile, Weathered Expanse continues to bleed heavily with over 3,400 casualties in two hours as Colonial forces consolidated six bases against one Warden position and two neutral sites. In Nevish Line, attrition remains severe with over 2,000 two-hour casualties, while the bitter contest in Callahan's Passage has cooled following earlier Warden consolidation.
